snippet.title: STEEL CORE – Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist STEEL CORE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4749570/Steel_Core/

STEEL CORE is a tactical turn-based strategy about giant mechs defending mining outposts on hostile worlds. Build each mech from parts, fortify your base, and survive an escalating roguelite campaign against an overwhelming alien enemy. Frontier work pays well, for those who survive it.

Developer: Starni Games
Publisher: Palaye
Video editing: Anton Orehov
